newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai airport opens new terminal building.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai airport opens new terminal building.

text.p: Shanghai's Hongqiao international airport opened a new terminal for domestic flights to cope with a boom in traffic, the Wen Hui Bao newspaper reported on Friday.
The airport will handle an estimated 102,000 inward and outward flights and 12.59 million people in 1996, up from actual 85,000 and 11 million in 1995, the newspaper said.

The new two-storey, 260 million yuan terminal, has an area of 51,000 square metres, with electronic announcement board, baggage handling and security equipment from U.S., France and Switzerland, it said.

To deal with the surge in air traffic, Shanghai is building a second, larger airport in the Pudong New Area, of which the first stage is due to be completed by 1999 at a cost of $1.45 billion. It will have four runways when finally completed.
